title: Milestone 2026.04.74 Operational Retrospective
improvement_trend_note: Third consecutive improvement: -155 min (-4.29%) vs .73 (3610 min). Delta from .58 baseline is now only +40 min (+1.17%) — the closest approach to the baseline in project history. However, improvement remains count-driven: 752 → 715 experiment count reduction (-37 experiments at 5.0 min/exp = ~185 min of volume reduction) exceeds the observed -155 min wall-time delta, suggesting some per-experiment latency regression absorbed part of the count savings. NOT structural: manifest enforcement unapplied, DualGPU not wired, four legacy slowest-5 carryovers unchanged.

count_analysis.count_above_cap_note: 715 experiments: 15 over the 700-experiment cap; down 37 from .73 (752), continuing the multi-milestone declining trend from the 806 peak in .72. First time within 20 of the cap since the regressions began.

This experiment has never been retired to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml despite 14 consecutive retirement recommendations. Violates CLAUDE.md failed-experiment-rerun discipline in every single milestone since .59. slowest_experiments.action_required: Immediately add to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml. Human override required for any future re-execution. Root cause must be diagnosed from results/experiment_786_*.json before re-introduction. 15 consecutive appearances with zero governance action represents the project's longest-running process failure.

Batching fix confirmed implemented (RETRO-SYMCODE-SERIAL closed in .64) but dispatch-site wiring never applied in 11 consecutive milestones. Runs serially at 51 min when one-line wiring fix would reduce runtime to ~15 min, saving ~36 min/milestone. Cumulative wiring-miss waste ~396 min (6.6 hours) across 11 post-fix milestones.
slowest_experiments.action_required: Wire SymCodeVerifier paragraph batching at dispatch site before .75 begins. If wiring cannot be applied, retire to exclusion_manifest.yaml. Eleven consecutive post-fix-but-not-wired milestones is indefensible. This is a one-line code change.

slowest_experiments.action_required: Apply CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=30 governor to ExperimentTemplate call for this experiment. Retire from unguarded queue pending diagnosis of live-training loop overrun root cause. This is a 30-minute engineering fix deferred for 15 consecutive milestones.

This experiment MUST NOT appear in .75 without explicit root-cause documentation and containment plan.
slowest_experiments.action_required: Read results/experiment_641_hermes_verifier_adapter_v2.json immediately. slowest_experiments.governance_status: SECOND CONSECUTIVE SLOW APPEARANCE — entered slowest-5 in .73 (new entrant, 35 min); ran at same 35-min runtime in .74 with no root-cause fix applied between milestones. Two consecutive appearances without diagnosis transitions this from 'new entrant to watch' to 'carryover pattern forming'. CLAUDE.md no-doomed-rerun discipline trigger at 3 consecutive appearances — one milestone away.
slowest_experiments.action_required: Root-cause diagnosis is mandatory before .75. Read results/experiment_906_*.json. Determine if cause is (a) SOTA model download overhead; (b) repair loop iteration overrun; (c) 50q scale × per-question latency. Apply CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=40 cap. Pre-download SOTA GGUFs before milestone begins. Do not allow this to become the next legacy carryover.

slowest5_governance.note: ZERO COMPOSITION CHANGE from .73 — all five slowest experiments identical to the prior milestone. Three legacy carryovers (786/627/603) now at 15 consecutive appearances; Exp 641 at 5 consecutive (2 past mandatory gate); Exp 906 at 2 consecutive (1 away from mandatory gate). This is the second milestone in a row with no composition change; the first such recurrence since the unprecedented 11-milestone freeze (.60–.70). Immediate governance action required before .75 to prevent re-entry into the frozen-composition pattern.

gpu_state_at_close.zombie_process_note: PID 1968339 holds 516 MB on GPU 0 with 4635.7s CPU time / 7900s wall time and 0% GPU utilization — this is an orphan/zombie inference process, likely a leaked subagent from conductor shutdown (see incident_2026_04_26_swap_saturation.md). Memory is held but GPU compute is idle, blocking 526 MB from experiment use. GPU Zombie Killer should have cleared this — potential regression or edge case in the killer's heuristics.
gpu_state_at_close.dualgpu_note: Both RTX 3090s at 0% utilization despite DualGPURunner benchmarked at 1.96-2.02x throughput. NINTH consecutive idle milestone post-deployment. Conductor GPU monitor explicitly recommends DualGPURunner with both GPUs idle and single Python inference process detected.

bottlenecks_identified: THREE 15TH-CONSECUTIVE LEGACY CARRYOVERS (Exp 786/627/603): cumulative slow-5 waste ~2,534 min (42.2 hours) since first appearance. Exclusion manifest unapplied for 15 consecutive milestones despite 15 consecutive retirement recommendations — the project's highest-priority governance failure.

EXP 641 (HermesVerifierAdapter v2): 5 consecutive slow appearances, 2 milestones past CLAUDE.md mandatory-gate threshold of 3 consecutive without root-cause diagnosis. Must not run in .75 without documented diagnosis and containment.

EXP 906 (IterativeSelfRepair 50q): 2 consecutive slow appearances at 35 min. Root cause undiagnosed between .73 and .74. One milestone from CLAUDE.md mandatory gate. Pre-flight SOTA model download fix not applied.

DUALGPU NOT WIRED: ninth consecutive idle milestone post-deployment (both RTX 3090s 0% util at 49C, 0C differential). DualGPURunner benchmarked at 1.96-2.02x; pipeline wiring would save ~60 min/milestone on GPU-bound experiments. Cumulative foregone savings ~540 min.

ZOMBIE PROCESS ON GPU 0: PID 1968339 holds 516 MB at 0% utilization (CPU 4635.7s / wall 7900s). GPU Zombie Killer either did not target this process or has a detection gap for long-running orphan subagents. Memory leak from conductor subagent shutdown (2026-04-26 incident).

SEQUENTIAL SINGLE-PROCESS INFERENCE: GPU monitor detects single Python inference process with 0-16 questions per forward pass recommended at 4-8x throughput improvement. Batching discipline from CLAUDE.md not enforced at runtime.
EXPERIMENT COUNT ABOVE 700 CAP: 715 experiments vs 700 target cap (+15 over). Count declining from 806 peak but enforcement mechanism unapplied.

COMPOSITION FREEZE RECURRENCE: Zero slowest-5 composition change from .73 — identical to the first milestone of the 11-milestone freeze (.60→.70). Immediate pre-flight action required to prevent re-entry into the frozen pattern.

IMPROVEMENT NOT STRUCTURAL: third consecutive improvement is again driven by experiment count reduction (-37 experiments at 5 min/exp = ~185 min volume savings), not governance fixes. If count stabilizes or rises, streak will stall and reverse.
improvements_suggested: IMMEDIATE (before .75 begins): Add Exp 786, Exp 627, and Exp 603 to ops/exclusion_manifest.yaml. This single action eliminates ~155-172 min of structural waste per milestone and is the load-bearing fix the project has needed for 15 consecutive milestones.
IMMEDIATE: Diagnose and document root cause for Exp 641 (HermesVerifierAdapter v2) from results/experiment_641_*.json. Apply 30-min timeout cap or retire to exclusion_manifest.yaml before .75.
IMMEDIATE: Diagnose Exp 906 root cause. Apply CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES=40 cap. Pre-download Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-GGUF and Gemma-4-31B-it-GGUF before .75 begins (~30 min prevention).

WIRE DUALGPU: Integrate DualGPURunner into VerifyRepairPipeline production path. Task has been deferred for 9 consecutive milestones. At 1.96-2.02x throughput, this saves ~60 min/milestone on GPU-heavy experiments. Assign as a .75 hard prerequisite, not an optional task.

FIX GPU ZOMBIE KILLER: Investigate why PID 1968339 (516 MB, 0% GPU, 7900s wall) was not cleared. The killer should target processes with >300s wall time + 0% GPU utilization + VRAM > 50 MB. Update heuristics or trigger interval if the current gap allows this class of orphan to persist.
ENFORCE 700-EXPERIMENT CAP: Add a conductor gate that refuses to schedule more than 700 experiments per milestone. Currently unenforced at the scheduling layer.

ADD TIMEOUT WATCHDOG: Apply a CARNOT_EXPERIMENT_TIMEOUT_MINUTES governor globally (default 30 min, overridable per-experiment). Estimated savings: 26 min/milestone from experiments that currently overrun.
BATCH INFERENCE ENFORCEMENT: Enforce batch_size=8-16 for GPU inference calls. GPU monitor explicitly recommends batching for 4-8x throughput improvement with single-process detected.

ELIMINATE MODEL DOWNLOAD OVERHEAD: Add a pre-flight SOTA GGUF download step at milestone start (before any experiment runs). Prevents 15-30 min first-run download latency from appearing inside timed experiments.
DOC RECONCILIATION BATCHING: Group all in-process doc reconciliation passes into two batches (mid-milestone and end-of-milestone) rather than per-experiment. Estimated savings: 20 min/milestone.
